title: The Great Santini
description: A teenager stands up to his father, a gung-ho peacetime Marine pilot who runs his family like boot camp.

title: The Betsy
description: An auto tycoon (Laurence Olivier) spites his corporate heir (Robert Duvall) by having a test driver (Tommy Lee Jones) build a bold new car.

title: Woman of the Year
description: Sam Craig, a New York sportswriter marries Tess Harding, a political columnist whose career comes first.

title: Designing Woman
description: A married sportswriter (Gregory Peck) and fashion designer (Lauren Bacall) have clashing friends.

title: Loophole
description: An investigator (Charles McGraw) hounds an innocent bank teller (Barry Sullivan) fired for robbing the till.

title: Operation Crossbow
description: A British commando (George Peppard) and his team drop into Germany and pose as scientists to pinpoint a Nazi rocket base.

title: It's Always Fair Weather
description: A talk-show staffer (Cyd Charisse) puts a fight manager (Gene Kelly), adman (Dan Dailey) and cook on TV 10 years after they parted as GIs.

title: Ninotchka
description: A playboy (Melvyn Douglas) charms a Russian envoy (Greta Garbo) sent to fetch three wayward comrades in Paris.

title: Deep Valley
description: A shy California farm girl (Ida Lupino) falls in love with a fugitive (Dane Clark) from a chain gang.

title: All the President's Men
description: The Washington Post's Bob Woodward (Robert Redford) and Carl Bernstein (Dustin Hoffman) tie the Watergate break-in to the White House.

title: The Manchurian Candidate
description: A Korean War hero's (Laurence Harvey) commanding officer (Frank Sinatra) discovers he and his platoon were brainwashed.

title: The Battleship Potemkin
description: Sergei Eisenstein's classic film depicts the mutiny aboard a czarist battleship during the failed revolution of 1905.

title: Three Colors: Blue
description: A Frenchwoman (Juliette Binoche) tries to withdraw from life after her daughter and composer husband die in a car crash.

title: Three Colors: White
description: Divorced and ruined in Paris, a Polish hairdresser (Zbigniew Zamachowski) gets even with his French ex-wife (Julie Delpy).

title: The Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Story
description: Actor Lionel Barrymore and Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer executive Dore Schary present clips from the studio's 1951 releases, including "Quo Vadis."

title: Noah's Ark
description: The same couple (Dolores Costello, George O'Brien) appear in parallel dramas of the Deluge and World War I.

title: The Squall
description: A gypsy woman applies her feminine charms to the male members of a farmhouse where she takes refuge during a storm.

title: The Great Divide
description: Posing as a bandido, a businessman abducts a Roaring '20s flapper hoping to reform her.

title: Show of Shows
description: The Warner Bros. revue, with master of ceremonies (Frank Fay), begins with 192 dancing girls on a huge staircase.

title: The Truth About Youth
description: A naive young man becomes enamored of a cabaret singer who has sampled liberally from amongst the male population.

title: The Naughty Flirt
description: A spoiled heiress leaves her boyfriend only to become involved with a man who secretly desires her money.

title: Consolation Marriage
description: A sportswriter (Pat O'Brien) jilted by his globe-trotting girlfriend (Myrna Loy) marries a woman (Irene Dunne) jilted by her boyfriend.

title: Rebound
description: A woman (Ina Claire) tries to make her husband (Robert Ames) forget his old flame (Myrna Loy), who is back.

title: Libeled Lady
description: An editor's fiancée and a lawyer help him trick an heiress suing his paper.

title: I Love You Again
description: A businessman (William Powell) snaps out of 9-year amnesia, reverts to con man and falls in love with his wife (Myrna Loy).

title: Love Crazy
description: An old flame (Gail Patrick) and a mother-in-law make a couple's (William Powell, Myrna Loy) fourth anniversary wacky.

title: Double Wedding
description: A dress designer (Myrna Loy) falls for a lazy artist (William Powell) after deeming him unworthy of her sister (Florence Rice).

title: Evelyn Prentice
description: A trial lawyer (William Powell) unwittingly defends another woman for a crime of passion committed by his wife (Myrna Loy).

title: Manhattan Melodrama
description: A district attorney (William Powell) condemns his boyhood buddy, a racketeer (Clark Gable) whose crime saves his bid for governor.

title: The Great Ziegfeld
description: The life and times of Broadway showman Florenz Ziegfeld and his two wives.

title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
description: Shakespeare's Puck (Mickey Rooney) and forest fairies prompt a triple mortal wedding, with entertainment by Bottom (James Cagney).

title: Hitler's Madman
description: The Nazi Heinrich Himmler condemns the Czech village Lidice after partisans kill the Nazi Reinhard Heydrich (John Carradine).

title: Escape From East Berlin
description: An East German (Don Murray) tunnels under the Berlin Wall and leads his girlfriend (Christine Kaufmann) and 26 others to freedom.

title: Friendly Persuasion
description: Indiana Quakers (Gary Cooper, Dorothy McGuire) disagree over their son's (Anthony Perkins) desire to join the Civil War.

title: Fury
description: On the way to see his sweetheart (Sylvia Sidney) a man (Spencer Tracy) is wrongly jailed and besieged by a lynch mob.

title: And Then There Were None
description: An unknown host (Barry Fitzgerald) brings 10 sinners to an island, for punishment one by one.

title: Murder, She Said
description: Agatha Christie's sleuth Miss Marple (Margaret Rutherford) gets a job at an estate where she thinks there's a corpse.

title: The Kennel Murder Case
description: Detective Philo Vance sifts through clues and comes up with seven possible suspects in the murder of a sportsman.

title: Suspicion
description: Alfred Hitchcock directs a thriller about a woman who thinks that her husband is plotting to murder her.

title: The Case of the Curious Bride
description: San Francisco lawyer and gourmet chef Perry Mason (Warren William) solves a murder at a cocktail party.

title: The Case of the Howling Dog
description: Lawyer Perry Mason (Warren William) shows the jury the truth about three murders stemming from a marital mix-up.

title: MGM Parade Show
description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

title: River's End
description: A fugitive (Charles Bickford) assumes the identity and love life of a look-alike Mountie dead in a blizzard.

title: The Prisoner of Zenda
description: Court followers foil a plot by having a British look-alike (Ronald Colman) pose as the king of Ruritania.

title: The Scarlet Pimpernel
description: London dandy Sir Percy (Leslie Howard) dons disguises to save French nobles from the Reign of Terror guillotine.

title: The Glass Slipper
description: Mistreated by her stepmother and stepsisters, scullery maid Ella (Leslie Caron) finally meets her prince (Michael Wilding).

title: When in Rome
description: A priest (Van Johnson) on a pilgrimage tours Roman cathedrals with an escaped convict (Paul Douglas) posing as a priest.

title: You Can't Fool Your Wife
description: An outcast husband (James Ellison) flirts with another woman who turns out to be his wife (Lucille Ball).
